title: Organization name (proposed demo demand)
practical_value: Proposed field-role demand in 3 demos. Organization classification/fuzzy discovery with explicit ambiguity.
licence_notes: Candidate metadata is unreconciled. Per-input data/model/meaning licences remain in demand-plan.json and recordset records; Employees-derived evidence retains CC-BY-SA-3.0. No blanket CC0 or canonical new meaning licence is asserted.
reason:
Related concepts, entity keys/names/attributes and physical roles remain separately qualified in assertions. Coverage means inspected hypothesis presence, not accepted semantic equivalence or external match rate.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Source-local person, customer, employee, supplier, store and business-entity IDs have no cross-demo or real-world identity. Customer/supplier/employer/operator are roles; organisation, legal entity, site and registration differ. A native PK/FK supports only its declared source relationship. Alternate unique names/GUIDs are source-scoped; names are not LEI/ROR/ORCID or a portable person key. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results. Examined 7 physical field-role hypotheses for this group; their individual dispositions govern implementation.
